descriptions.text: bZx was attacked again with an estimated loss of $645,000 of ETH
DeFi lending protocol bZx exploited, may lose up to $350,000.

On February 15, 2020, bZx's Fulcrum protocol suffered a flash-loan-powered exploit, causing a major loss of ETH after a leveraged margin trade was executed with a severely price-impacted swap. The protocol failed to enforce a post-slippage position health check, enabling the attacker to drain collateral and profit from arbitrage. bZx's Fulcrum margin trading contract failed to validate position health after a high-slippage leveraged swap. A logic bug let the collateralization check be bypassed, allowing a severely undercollateralized position to be opened and exploited.
